name: apple_new_id_min
note: Lower id bound for the newer band. Remeasure against ISRC years before the next calendar year.

name: apple_new_year_min
note: Lower year bound of the newer band. Remeasure against ISRC years before the next calendar year.

name: apple_catalog_id_max
note: Exclusive upper id bound for the older band. Remeasure against ISRC years before the next calendar year.

name: apple_catalog_year_max
note: Upper year bound of the older band. Remeasure against ISRC years before the next calendar year.

name: isrc_new_max_years
note: Calendar years back that count as new. Review this rule with the Apple bands before the next calendar year.
